_header: Daily hard caps (USD) on paid LLM calls, per caller group (Chad 11-04). Read by api/lib/spend-caps.js. DAY BOUNDARY = the UTC day, the same one the ai_usage daily rollup uses (ai-usage-repo rollupSpend: date('now') / toISOString). A caller maps to the FIRST rule it matches (exact or prefix), else `default`. Each cap entry applies from its `from` date (UTC) until a later entry replaces it. Env override: SPEND_CAP_<GROUP>_USD (e.g. SPEND_CAP_MEDIA_USD=60). Callers in `exempt` are counted but never refused (user search must not stop). Anthropic batch calls count at their half-price rate, when the batch result is logged.
_improve: Improvement cycle (Opus 5.5 judge on every search trace + reply, deep analysis on weak ones; Chad 11-04). Chad 11-04: 'a forensics budget which we will start large but reduce over time. For now it should cover everything.' $200/day covers the measured projection ($75-170/day: $0.0098/judged reply, $0.031/deep analysis); lower it by adding a later dated entry (long-run target $5/day). Over the cap the improve worker DELAYS work (weak replies first, then new searches, then backfill), never drops it.

providers._note: Provider-wide daily caps (Chad 11-06: "cap anthropic costs to $20/day. when it hits that budget, queue up the work"). Every group's calls to the provider count toward `usd`. Background groups stop at `background_usd`, so the rest is kept for live Anís replies (groups in `interactive`); `usd` stops everything. Env override: SPEND_CAP_<PROVIDER>_TOTAL_USD.
